heroHeadline: Madrid Residency Closes at 630,000 Fans; Bad Bunny Tops $1B Touring Gross, Toy Story 5 Scores Year's Biggest Opening, First Latin Artist to Headline a UK Stadium
heroSubtitle: Since the June 7 update, Bad Bunny closed his historic 10-night Madrid residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano (Cluster 4: Mora, June 10-11; Cluster 5 finale: Lunay, Chuwi, Dei V, Quevedo, June 14-15), drawing roughly 630,000 cumulative fans. Pollstar confirmed he crossed $1,008,918,203 in career touring gross on May 22, 2026 in Barcelona -- the fastest of any artist this century to reach $1B and the first Latin artist to do so. Pixar's Toy Story 5 opened worldwide June 19 with Bad Bunny voicing 'Pizza with Sunglasses,' scoring 2026's biggest box-office opening ($312M global). The European stadium leg continued through Dusseldorf (June 20-21), Arnhem (June 23-24), and a historic Tottenham Hotspur Stadium stand (June 27-28, 104,000 fans) -- the first Latin American artist to headline a UK stadium, with Novak Djokovic and Gorillaz's Damon Albarn making surprise appearances. Bad Bunny and longtime partner Gabriela Berlingeri were then spotted together at Wimbledon (June 29). The tour moved on to Marseille (July 1), Paris La Defense Arena (July 4-5), Stockholm (July 10-11), and Warsaw (July 14). 'DtMF' extended its all-time Hot Latin Songs No. 1 record to a 67th consecutive week (chart dated July 11, 2026). Milan (July 17-18) and the Brussels finale (July 22) remain.
